notes.content: Vehicles were softlocked due to port conversion, changes have been made, should be able to drive with keyboard now. Also, mouse can be used to circle player now

notes.title: Poly Mode Update
notes.content:
List of major changes:

- City Explorer is now Poly Mode
- new city called 'Fasco', arcade has been moved here.
- new city called 'Pendle'
- new board game called 'Vast Space'
- new board game called 'Junkyard'
- new board game settings that allow you to choose what minigames you want to play and don't want to play in board games.
- CPU racers have been modified.

Lots of changes have taken place since the last update, more can be found at dhoodproductions.com

notes.title: Poly Party Update
notes.content:
Poly Party has been updated! There's a new Racer Nation Event 'Riders Edge', Minigames have been changed, some redone, Boardgames now have a fast-forward button, along with a Missile Button that can be dropped on opposing players, City Explorer has had some environment changes.

More to come, other changes that may not be noted here, since launch, can be found at https://www.dhoodproductions.com/game-updates
